description: This file defines the ElementHandle class for interacting with DOM elements in Playwright, including methods for querying, interacting, and taking screenshots of elements. It also includes utility functions for handling file uploads and screenshot types.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a DOM element, providing methods to interact with and query the element.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an ElementHandle instance from a channel handle.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates an ElementHandle instance from a channel handle, or returns null if handle is undefined.

methods.name: ownerFrame
methods.description: Returns the frame that owns this element handle.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Returns the content frame if the element is an iframe.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Gets the current value of an input element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content of the element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets the inner text of the element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio button is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event of a given type.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if needed.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks the element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks the element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with a value.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects text within the element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for an input element.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Presses a key.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state of a checkbox.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the element.

methods.description: Waits for the element to reach a specific state.
